change: Evaluate resumable reference discovery only when native-code reference discovery returns no result, and remove its unused Result wrapper.

contract.before: Compute native-code references and resumable references eagerly, discard the latter when the former exists, then send each selected edge to the visitor.
contract.after: Compute native-code references; only when absent compute resumable references; send the same selected edges to the visitor.
preserved: The native-code result has the same priority, including an empty result.
Resumable reference discovery has no error return, Id send or state mutation; its former Result was always Ok.
Selected edge order, live visitor sends, visitor failures, Block fallback, snapshots and roots are unchanged.
Representation-specific reads remain inside Execution. No Id or public ABI changes.

microbenchmark.scope: Existing Execution referencesOf:do: through Id. A declared native provider records the context supplied to its own factory; no Method introspection or new context accessor is used. Native context reports factory, source and Method; ordinary Block fallback reports its Method. Visitor checks every edge and its order. 50000 calls/sample, seven samples/process, ABBA. GC outside timing; automatic-GC policy unchanged.

full_collection.scope: Full precise collection after 1000 Integer/Range iterations; automatic GC disabled only while producing garbage, same policy in both lanes. Six collection timings per variant, two fresh processes, ABBA. Successful nonempty collections checked.

validation: capture_access, execution_machines and continuation_transparency passed, covering foreign-storage rejection, aliases, budgets, suspension, reentry and lifetimes.
The microbenchmark verifies every reference and order for native contexts and ordinary Blocks, collects between samples, and checks the provider body still executes correctly.

Full Oop core checks passed: owner unit tests, compiler/GC smoke, direct-dispatch and construction contracts, export audit, independent C cold caller, cross-thread rejection and finalizer containment.
contract_review: Inspection of the entire resumable helper found only reads of private return/record maps, storage facts and engine roots. Its visitor closures only append to a temporary Vec. All return paths were Ok. Therefore the unused fallback can be skipped without suppressing a language error or callback. The externally visible visitor loop and its failure propagation are unchanged.
limits: Native-context tracing used 7.1% less CPU; the ordinary Block control used 2.0% more in this run. Report this small mixed control result rather than claiming a uniform speedup.
Full-collection CPU changed -1.2% after the Integer loop and +1.8% after Range. These small mixed results do not establish a general GC or application speedup.
Four fresh processes, serial ABBA, seven focused samples per process. Automatic GC policy unchanged in the focused test; explicit collection outside its timer.
Only libbirnam_execution.dylib differs across 783 prefix files. Controlled library substitution, not a fresh installed release. User installation unchanged.
